headline: NY high sheet calls the overnight reading at 100% whenever the live forecast times out (16 of 59 rows tonight; fix on this branch, merge before noon), and the 11-16 refit ran on empty forecasts and switched off every tuned setting (dispatch kalshi-nightly.yml before 12:00 ET).

findings.title: Timed-out live forecast makes the sheet call the overnight floor at 100%
findings.evidence: trail ny_high_2026-11-17: 16/59 rows models null, pred 44.81 = hmax, p 1.0 on '54 or below' vs market 57-58 at 0.59-0.64; run 44060791125 log 'live run unavailable (handshake timed out); today falls back to archive'; forecast_runs archive ends yesterday so no model has today; snapshot() (noon lock) has the same fallback. Replay: live ok -> pred 54.6, live timeout -> pred 44.813.

findings.title: 11-16 refit ran on empty forecasts and switched off every tuned setting
findings.evidence: 9844aabdf (run 72, 18:52Z 11-16, before fix aa234d215 at 00:32Z): tuned.json ny_high why 'incumbent replay failed', n removed; bake applies active only if n >= 45, so mkt_pull 0.65->0, pub_pull 0.75->0, drop_worst 0->2, wind_regime true->false since then (11-16 lock params). TUNER row still shows 0.65/0.75. price_study.json hour_rows 1521->0, calib/blend/flip/exit empty. Dispatch kalshi-nightly.yml before 12:00 ET.
